propositions: Create canonical `rebar bridge status` and hidden `bridge-status` alias as read-only entrypoints with identical parser, options, text/JSON schemas, and exit codes while preview/sync/pause/resume remain unchanged.

Consolidate two pass-record producers into one authoritative minimal JSON record written to `refs/reconciler/last-pass` via observed-OID CAS with three attempts and 100/200ms backoff, advancing before lock release and recording success or process-surviving failure.

Implement exact verdict precedence PAUSED>RUNNING>FOREIGN>FAILED>STALE>HEALTHY with specific exit codes (0 for HEALTHY/PAUSED/RUNNING, 1 for STALE/FOREIGN/NEVER_RUN/FAILED), where NEVER_RUN applies only when no durable record and no live lock exist.

Use explicit `REBAR_ENV_ID` for CI or stable `local:<repo-env-id>` from `.env-id` for local last-pass writer and status target, rejecting missing/empty `.env-id` as hard configuration error without fallback to `reconciler`.

Detect crash via two read-only fence snapshots separated by observed holder `lease_secs`; unchanged OID/fence indicates CRASHED, advancing fence indicates RUNNING; reject observed leases above 480 seconds as operational failure.

Canary defaults to canonical `bridge status` source after producer bootstrap write, preserves existing ticket escalation and dedup, supports one-release explicit `REBAR_CANARY_HEARTBEAT_SOURCE=github-api` rollback, and fetches `refs/reconciler/*` without querying GitHub Actions API.
